metadata.purpose: Paired original versus synthetic colloquial query perturbations for a frozen query-rewrite pilot
metadata.selection_rule: Filter source queries to split == 'test'; sort unique family_id by ascending SHA256('r6-family:' + family_id).hexdigest(); select first 20 families; retain en and zh for each family.
metadata.author: Codex AI assistant
limitations: Synthetic AI-authored perturbations, not real user logs or human colloquial annotations.
Inherits question ambiguity, deictic references, and translation/wording defects; affected questions are not silently repaired.
Existing answer/relevance labels are inherited provisionally by the experiment runner; they are not included or newly judged in this file.
The original public QA items are not a representative undergraduate computer-science course benchmark.
Forty queries are twenty paired language families and are not forty independent information needs.
